DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //wuw.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 73 s. 2022 JUL 2 9 2022 ATTY. ANTHONY C. NUYDA Regional Director, DILG-Region V Rizal Street, Legazpi City Dear RD Nuyda: This has reference to your Memorandum dated 18 March 2022 referring to the Central Office the letter dated 21 February 2022 of Hon. Mark Justin B. Fernandez, President, SK Pambayang Pederasyon, Bagamanoc, Catanduanes, requesting guidance on the following: ii. Pursuant to Section 22(c) of the SK Reform Act of 2015, the SK Pederasyon President should be an ex-officio member of the Sanggunian and Local Special Bodies, namely the Local School Board, Local Council for the Protection of Children Local Development Council, Local Health Board, Local Tourism Council and Local Peace and Order Council. However, in the Implementint Rules and Regulations (IRR) of the SK Reform Act of 2015, the said provision was apparently not included in Section 23 thereof; In a copy of the SK Reform Act of 2015 in the Official Gazette, he noted that there were no commas separating the names of the local special bodies under Section 22(c) thereof, which particularly states "xxx Local Council for the Protection of Children Local Development Council, Local Health Board Local Tourism Council and Local Peace and Order Council" On the first request for guidance, this Department agrees with your adherence in the ruling in Echegaray vs. the Secretary of Justice, et al. that an IRR must remain consistent and in harmony with the law it seeks to apply and implement. The administrative rules and regulations are intended to carry out, neither to supplant nor modify the law. As such, in case of discrepancy between a provision of statute and a rule or regulation issued to implement said statute, the statutory provision prevails. On the second request, under the rule of construction known as "ejusdem generis" (the same kind or specie), where general words follow the enumeration of particular classes of persons or things, the general words will be construed as applicable only to persons or things of the same general nature or class as those enumerated. The rule is based on the obvious reason that if the legislature had intended the general words to be used in their unrestricted sense they would have made no mention of the particular classes. General words, which standing alone might have a wide and comprehensive meaning, when joined with an enumeration of articles, things, and entities will be interpreted in "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline NO.: 8876-34-54

their narrower sense and understood to refer only to articles, things and entities fairly similar in kind, class and nature to those set forth in the associated list of enumerationl Accordingly, we opine that Local Council for the Protection of Children and Local Development Council is separate and distinct from each other, which equally applies to Local Health Board and Local Tourism Council. This opinion should be without prejudice to any contrary opinion rendered by more competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have guided you on the matter. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY. I GAN Undersec ary for Local Gover ment OUSLG/MLl/LLLS-LRALLD/rra0/clp 1 The City of Manila, et al. vs. Juan Entote, G.R. NO.
